body_lead: Gridlock-free Hyderabad: Telangana plans to implement AI-based traffic signal management system The tech leaders explained the chief minister Reddy and government officials on an ongoing Hyderabad traffic pilot project By - Newsmeter Network |Hyderabad: Telangana government is planning to roll out an artificial intelligence (AI) powered traffic signal management system to curb congestion in Hyderabad.
